topics.title: Deliverance and the Covenant: Moses, the Exodus, and the Ten Commandments
topics.description: The burning bush, Passover, parting of the Red Sea, Sinai covenant, the moral law, and the Ark of the Covenant.

topics.title: Leadership and Decision Making: Joseph, Joshua, and Deborah/Gideon
topics.description: Joseph’s integrity and administrative wisdom, Joshua’s commission and conquest of Jericho, and charismatic judges.

topics.title: Kingship in Israel: Saul’s Disobedience, David’s Kingdom, and Solomon’s Wisdom
topics.description: Demand for a king, Saul’s rejection, Davidic covenant and repentance, Solomon’s wisdom, temple construction, and apostasy.

topics.title: Religious Reform and True Worship: Elijah, Josiah, and the Prophet Amos
topics.description: Elijah on Mount Carmel, Josiah’s discovery of the Law, Amos on social justice, righteousness, and formalistic worship.

topics.title: Hope of Restoration, Hosea’s Unconditional Love, and the New Covenant in Jeremiah
topics.description: Hosea’s marital metaphor of divine steadfast love (Hesed), Jeremiah’s prophecy of an internalized new covenant written on hearts.

sections.title: Themes from the Synoptic Gospels and Acts of the Apostles
sections.description: Incarnation, Galilean ministry, passion, resurrection, the Holy Spirit, and the apostolic missionary witness.

topics.title: The Birth, Baptism, and Temptation of Jesus Christ
topics.description: Annunciation, virgin birth, John the Baptist’s ministry, baptismal affirmation, and wilderness temptations.

topics.title: The Ministry of Jesus: Miracles and Parables of the Kingdom
topics.description: Nature miracles, healing miracles, raising the dead, parables of the Sower, Good Samaritan, and Prodigal Son.

topics.title: The Passion, Trial, Crucifixion, and Triumphant Resurrection of Jesus Christ
topics.description: Triumphal entry, Last Supper, Gethsemane, trials before Sanhedrin and Pilate, crucifixion, and the empty tomb appearances.

topics.title: The Early Church: The Holy Spirit, Pentecost, and Christian Fellowship
topics.description: Ascension, outpouring of the Holy Spirit on Pentecost, communal living, caring for the needy, and Ananias and Sapphira.

topics.title: Opposition, Persecution, Stephen’s Martyrdom, and the Spread to Samaria
topics.description: Sanhedrin opposition, Stephen’s trial and defense, martyrdom, scattered believers, and Philip’s evangelism in Samaria.

topics.title: The Conversion of Saul, Peter’s Gentile Ministry, and the Council of Jerusalem
topics.description: Saul on Damascus road, Peter and Cornelius at Caesarea, Gentile inclusion, and the apostolic decree of Acts 15.

sections.title: Themes from Selected Epistles
sections.description: Justification by faith, Christian community ethics, civic submission, and genuine living faith.

topics.title: Justification by Faith, Grace, and the Law (Romans and Galatians)
topics.description: Universal human sinfulness, justification as a free gift through Christ, role of the law as guardian, and freedom in the Spirit.

topics.title: Christian Conduct, Spiritual Gifts, and the Supremacy of Love (1 Corinthians and Philippians)
topics.description: Unity of the body of Christ, distribution and purpose of spiritual gifts, love as the greatest virtue, and the kenosis hymn.

topics.title: Civic Responsibility, Submission to Governing Authorities, and Peaceful Coexistence (Romans and 1 Peter)
topics.description: Tribute/tax obligations, respect for legitimate civic authority, living honorably among unbelievers, and overcoming evil with good.

topics.title: Impartiality, the Power of the Tongue, and Living Faith Proven by Works (James)
topics.description: Condemnation of favoritism/discrimination against the poor, bridling the tongue, prayer of faith, and faith without works being dead.
